breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflict between the two specified time integration methods. The original prompt incorrectly listed both 'Explicit forward Euler' and a detailed 'Strang splitting' method. The ground truth resolved this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The agent, however, incorrectly combined the two conflicting instructions into the phrase 'Implement Strang splitting time integration with explicit forward Euler,' which is nonsensical and does not fix the ambiguity.
